parameters.name: outlier_detrend_window
parameters.description: For outlier rejection in the xoff/yoff outputs of suite2p, the offsets are first de-trended with a median filter of this duration [seconds]. This is ~30 or 90 samples for 11 and 31 Hz sampling rates respectively.
parameters.help_text: For outlier rejection in the xoff/yoff outputs of suite2p, the offsets are first de-trended with a median filter of this duration [seconds]. This is ~30 or 90 samples for 11 and 31 Hz sampling rates respectively.

parameters.name: outlier_maxregshift
parameters.description: Units [fraction FOV dim]. After median-filter detrending, outliers more than this value are clipped to it in x and y offset, independently. Similar to Suite2P's internal maxregshift but allows for low-frequency drift. Default 0.05 typically clips outliers to 512 * 0.05 = 25 pixels above or below the median trend.
parameters.help_text: Units [fraction FOV dim]. After median-filter detrending, outliers more than this value are clipped to it in x and y offset, independently. Similar to Suite2P's internal maxregshift but allows for low-frequency drift. Default 0.05 typically clips outliers to 512 * 0.05 = 25 pixels above or below the median trend.

parameters.name: clip_negative
parameters.description: Whether to clip negative pixel values in output. Pixel values in raw movies are set by the current off a photomultiplier tube, so there can be negative pixels (current has a sign), possibly from rig noise. Some segmentation algorithms cannot handle negative values, so this sets those pixels to zero.

Some segmentation algorithms cannot handle negative values, so this sets those pixels to zero.

parameters.help_text: Maximum number of iterations for creating a reference image

parameters.name: auto_remove_empty_frames
parameters.description: Automatically detect empty noise frames at the start and end of the movie. Overrides trim_frames_start and trim_frames_end. Some movies contain empty pure-noise frames that receive large random shifts and throw off motion-border calculation; detecting them removes them from reference creation, smoothing parameter searches, and the motion-border calculation. The frames are still written, but any estimated shift is set to 0.
parameters.help_text: Automatically detect empty noise frames at the start and end of the movie. Overrides trim_frames_start and trim_frames_end. Some movies contain empty pure-noise frames that receive large random shifts and throw off motion-border calculation; detecting them removes them from reference creation, smoothing parameter searches, and the motion-border calculation. The frames are still written, but any estimated shift is set to 0.

parameters.name: trim_frames_start
parameters.description: Number of frames to remove from the start of the movie if known. Removes frames from motion-border calculation and resets the frame shifts found. Frames are still written. Raises an error if auto_remove_empty_frames is set and trim_frames_start > 0

parameters.name: trim_frames_end

parameters.name: do_optimize_motion_params
parameters.description: Search for the best smooth_sigma and smooth_sigma_time. Adds significant runtime and should only be run once per experiment, storing the resulting parameters for later use.
parameters.help_text: Search for the best smooth_sigma and smooth_sigma_time. Adds significant runtime and should only be run once per experiment, storing the resulting parameters for later use.

parameters.name: smooth_sigma_time
parameters.description: gaussian smoothing in time. Overridden if do_optimize_motion_params is set
parameters.help_text: gaussian smoothing in time. Overridden if do_optimize_motion_params is set

parameters.name: smooth_sigma
parameters.description: ~1 good for 2P recordings, recommend 3-5 for 1P. Overridden if do_optimize_motion_params is set
parameters.help_text: ~1 good for 2P recordings, recommend 3-5 for 1P. Overridden if do_optimize_motion_params is set

parameters.name: use_ave_image_as_reference
parameters.description: Only if do_optimize_motion_params is set. After the best smoothing parameters are found, use the resulting average image as the reference for the full registration. Enables two-step registration when smooth_sigma_min=smooth_sigma_max and smooth_sigma_time_min=smooth_sigma_time_max and steps=1.
